title: MySQL database security evidence baseline
description: Declarative, read-only metadata evidence for security assurance in customer-validated MySQL environments.

controls.title: Review transport-security metadata
controls.objective: Collect transport-enforcement and current-session cipher metadata for comparison with the approved policy.

applicability.notes: Loopback development may use a documented TLS exception; remote environments require verified TLS.

limitations: This probe describes server policy and the collector session, not every client or backup path.

remediation.guidance: Review TLS policy, certificates, clients, and rollback before changing transport settings.

controls.title: Review database object inventory
controls.objective: Collect table and view names so an authorized reviewer can confirm scope without reading application rows.

applicability.notes: The probe reads information_schema metadata for the selected database only.

limitations: Object inventory does not classify columns or inspect any application values.

remediation.guidance: Reconcile the inventory with the approved asset scope before changing database objects.

controls.title: Review collector account context
controls.objective: Collect the authenticated account and active role so an authorized reviewer can verify the intended read-only identity.

applicability.notes: Grant verification remains a separate administrator responsibility.

limitations: Account context alone does not enumerate privileges or prove least privilege.

remediation.guidance: Use a dedicated account restricted to SELECT and SHOW VIEW on the assessed database.

controls.title: Review masking governance evidence
controls.objective: Require evidence that non-production data uses suitable masking and preserves privacy, relationships, and application utility.

applicability.notes: No masking probe is approved, so review remains manual.

manual_evidence_requirements: Approved masking policy and scoped data classification

limitations: This control does not execute masking or inspect raw values.

remediation.guidance: Use an approved masking mechanism and attach authorized validation evidence.
